RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Not reliably estimable from these facts

An all-male panel is worth questioning as a process issue, but it is not, by itself, evidence that sex influenced the decision. Your qualifications warrant a substantive explanation; the announcement alone cannot establish whether you were the stronger candidate against the selection criteria.

Follow up in writing requesting the criteria, your assessment scores, and the reasons for the decision. You can neutrally ask how panel members were selected and what safeguards ensured fair assessment.

Stronger warning signs include sex-based remarks, inconsistent criteria, or unequal questioning. Two weeks’ silence alone establishes little. Check local complaint deadlines now; waiting for an explanation may not pause them.
